title: The Risen
summary: Wraiths who return to their own bodies.

claims.text: The Risen are wraiths back in their own corpses: the wounds that killed them show as heavy scars, lost limbs stay lost, and they have no breath, pulse or warmth.
A would-be Risen needs a willing Shadow, a usable body and a Conduit to pass through.

title: Persephone
summary: The first of the dead said to cross back.

claims.text: Once a wraith called Persephone found a way back into the living world, many more followed, more than the Deathlords like to admit.
It is said Persephone grew madder with each crossing between worlds; those who claim to have met Persephone describe a young figure with the light of madness in the eyes.

title: Factions and the Risen
summary: How Renegades and Heretics use the walking dead.

claims.text: Renegades see the Risen as dangerous to the Hierarchy and useful as agents among the living, and many Risen carry out some favor for a Renegade leader.
Every Heretic cult holds a strong view of the Risen; the Path of the United Being teaches that a wraith must reunite with its body and overcome death to Transcend.
